notes: MH3U/MH3G blademaster constants. Coefficients divide displayed raw: hunting horn and switch axe are 4.6 in MH3U, not MHFU's 5.2, and long sword is 3.3, not 4.8. The sharpness table is fixed: green 1.05/1.00, blue 1.20/1.0625, white 1.32/1.125, purple 1.44/1.20; the MHFU values 1.125/1.25/1.30/1.50 do not apply. Some English tables round elemental blue/white to 1.06/1.13; the exact MH3U values are 1.0625/1.125. Sharpness +1 extends the gauge by one colour step and can reveal purple, but it does not change these multipliers. MH3U has no Sharpness +2 skill, so there is no second sharpness table. rawModifiers are class/mode corrections, not unconditional class-wide multipliers: SnS blade attacks always get 1.06 (SnS and DB elemental attacks also get a 0.70x modifier in MH3U); dual blades get 1.15 only in Demon Mode; switch axe gets 1.20 only in sword mode with a Power Phial (Element Phial is 1.25x elemental, not raw); gunlance has no melee raw penalty in MH3U because the old 0.97x gunlance correction was removed from MHP3 onward, so it is 1.0. If the damage model cannot represent modes/phials, DB and SA should be treated as 1.0 rather than applying these conditional bonuses to every hit. Element Atk Up is 1.2x in MH3U; it does not stack with a specific Element Atk +2 (both are 1.2x). Purple is given as 1.44 by the MH3G wiki and calculator; a few later-game or secondary tables show 1.45, which is the MH4/MH4U value, not MH3U.
